Nadia: Postmortem follow-up: we need a compact remediation plan so the eviction/regression pattern doesn't recur. small, test-driven items.
Colin: list them and I'll pick owners. prioritize anything that stops customer-facing failures.
Nadia: Proposed items: (1) 20-case prompt/regression set for eviction+fallback failures; (2) nightly regression job that runs eviction scenarios on a small canary fleet; (3) burst-load template (small-batch, high concurrency) + metrics capture; (4) 15-min chaos runbook for shard restart on staging; (5) rollout gate: fail deploy if any critical prompt drops >5%.
Rahul: i'll own (2) the nightly job. will piggyback on the existing runner and add a minimal dataset. ETA 2025-02-10.
Colin: i'll take (1) prompt/regression set. plan recorded traces + synthetic variants, annotate pass/fail and a tiny scoring harness. ETA 2025-02-04.
Nadia: who wants (3) burst template? need tail-latency and queue-length logging to match incident signals.
Colin: I can help but prefer Rahul for infra. Rahul: ok i'll add the template to perf repo as a parameterized job. ETA 2025-01-30.
Rahul: for (4) chaos runbook, coordinate with Eng-SRE. keep blast radius tiny; run on staging only. target window after nightly job lands. ETA 2025-02-14.
Nadia: gating (5) is important. suggestion: if any critical prompt in the prompt set drops >5% absolute, the rollout pipeline fails and auto-creates a remediation ticket assigned to oncall.
Colin: agree. i'll draft a short RFC to wire eval alerts into the rollout webhook.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up review 2025-01-22 13:00 UTC  attendees: Nadia, Colin, Rahul.
Nadia: Action recap: A1 prompt/regression set 7 owner: Colin 7 due: 2025-02-04; A2 nightly eviction regression job 7 owner: Rahul 7 due: 2025-02-10; A3 burst-load template 7 owner: Rahul 7 due: 2025-01-30; A4 chaos runbook 7 owner: Rahul 7 due: 2025-02-14; A5 gating RFC 7 owner: Colin 7 due: 2025-01-28.
Colin: i'll open the prompt PR today and tag Nadia.
Rahul: i'll open the perf PR and include a small runbook for running locally to validate.
Nadia: please add tickets to the postmortem board and tag "remediation" and "evals". keep CI-local tests short; full-runs nightly. ping me if blocked.
